cq_coverage.1: InterchangeEnvelope (containsMessage) -> Message (hasSegment) -> InvoiceMessage. All invoices in an EDIFACT message are instances of InvoiceMessage related via containsMessage.
cq_coverage.2: InvoiceMessage (involvesOrganization) -> Organization. All organizations involved are linked to the invoice.
cq_coverage.3: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasOrganization, hasRole, hasRoleContext). Role of organization S is found by querying OrganizationRoleInInvoice where hasOrganization = S and hasRoleContext = invoice.
cq_coverage.4: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasRole = Buyer, hasRoleContext = invoice). Buyer is found by role assignment in OrganizationRoleInInvoice.
cq_coverage.5: Organization, Address, Identifier, OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasAddress, hasIdentifier, hasRole). Information about organizations is modeled via these classes/properties.
cq_coverage.6: OrganizationRoleInInvoice (hasRole = Buyer, hasAddress). Buyer's address is via OrganizationRoleInInvoice with Buyer role.
cq_coverage.7: InvoiceMessage (hasLineItem) -> LineItem (hasItem). Items sold are linked via hasLineItem and hasItem.
cq_coverage.8: Item, LineItem (hasNetPrice, hasQuantity, hasPrice). Information about items is given by these properties/classes.
cq_coverage.9: LineItem (hasNetPrice). Net price for each item is captured by hasNetPrice.
cq_coverage.10: InvoiceMessage (hasInvoiceNumber, hasInvoiceAmount, hasHeaderSection, hasDetailSection, hasSummarySection). Invoice details are modeled via these properties and sections.
cq_coverage.13: All structural elements (InterchangeEnvelope, Message, Segment, CompositeDataElement, SimpleDataElement, etc.) and required identifiers (Identifier, GlobalLocationNumber). File format validity is ensured by the presence of these elements and their relations.
cq_coverage.14: InvoiceMessage (assignedToBusinessProcess). Assignment to BusinessProcess is modeled with this property.
